name: TypeMaster
description: Typing practice app with accounts, lessons and progress tracking.
notes: Needs Postgres on localhost:5432 with a typemaster_dev database. Migrate once with: DATABASE_URL=postgres://localhost:5432/typemaster_dev npm run migrate -w packages/db

name: LocalSpace
description: Private, local-first documentation platform. Nothing leaves your machine.
notes: Builds the web app, then serves everything from one port. Only one copy can use the database at a time.

name: TheoryDrive IE
description: Prepare for the Irish RSA Category B driver theory test. Learn, practise, pass.
command: npm run predev && npx next dev -p {port}
notes: The predev step creates and seeds the SQLite database on every start.

name: XML Compare
description: Compare two XML files by raw source or by structure and content.
notes: Runs run.mjs, which sets up the Python venv and node_modules for this OS (Windows, macOS, Linux, WSL), then starts the Django API on 8010 and the Vite UI on the port above.

name: CleanYourTV
description: Strip bloatware from an Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and install a clean launcher.
notes: Not a web app. It talks to your TV, so there is nothing to run here. Open the README for the steps.

name: DiffLens
description: Local-first AI code review. Review your changes before pushing, or review team PRs through gh.
notes: Binds to 127.0.0.1 only. Data lives in ~/Library/Application Support/DiffLens. Under construction: Phase 1 of 7 is done (dashboard and database); reviews arrive in later phases.
